_comment: Hardware config for cevit_pipeline.py. Peaks in TFLOPS, utilisations in 0..1, bandwidths in GB/s, frequency in Hz. The partition is the STAGES table in cevit_pipeline.py, not here.
_comment_cores: num_core_per_cluster of the matching software/runtime/multi_cluster/configs/arch_*.py. Only the layout kernels (patchify, transpose) read it: a permutation carries no FLOPs, so it is charged per element per core rather than against a peak -- see LAYOUT_CYCLES_PER_ELEM in cevit_pipeline.py.
_comment_util: PE_utilization derates the PE path (non-GEMM everywhere, plus GEMMs on a pool with no tensor engine). TE_utilization derates GEMM_peak on pools that have one (TensorPool's RedMulE) and does not affect Terapool.
_comment_links: bandwidth_c2c_gbs is the on-chip cluster-to-cluster link. bandwidth_lpddr_gbs is PER CHANNEL; an off-chip leg is charged at bandwidth_lpddr_gbs * lpddr_channels capped by bandwidth_c2c_gbs, since the bytes still cross the on-chip network. With these values the cap does not bind.
